decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable with steady demand in the dental lab workflow, and the firm's own-page promotion suggests the option value remains positive.
PETG thermoforming blanks are tied to the growing clear-aligner and digital orthodontics segment, so the option has high upside and keeping it open is cheap relative to its strategic potential.
UV-curing lacquer is likely a low-cost post-processing material for digital dental workflows, and its modest website presence still leaves enough upside uncertainty to justify holding the option.
Custom hearing protection earmolds are costly to produce and overlap with the already-dropped earmold product line, so revealed demand is unlikely to justify continued investment.
